messages:
sam: heads-up — onboarding hit a weird one: js quickstart (v1.3.0) running embeddings -> rerank helper returns mixed-length vectors in same batch.

nia: yikes. any raw bodies or request-id? which model?

sam: model=openembed-large-2025-08, quickstart tag redwood/quickstart:latest. raw dump with REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 shows candidate A with 1535 floats and B with 1536. sampleapp crashes when doing new Float32Array(1536) on the whole set.

sdk-js: thanks, this rings a bell — we changed the streaming parse and introduced a concat optimization. If a retry happens while streaming, partial chunks from attempt1 + attempt2 can be stitched together incorrectly. Also there
was a short-lived field-name inconsistency (`vector` vs `embedding`) in a gateway rollout which can mix keys.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-330 embed-rerank-stream-concat (priority: medium)

nia: short-term workaround: set env REDWOOD_AUTOBATCH=false or call client.rerank.batch(..., autobatch: false). That avoids the streaming concat path. Also normalize fields post-parse: const vec = candidate.embedding || candidate.vector; assert(vec.length === expectedLen).

sdk-python: python SDK had a similar change last quarter and includes a normalization step; we'll mirror that for JS.

sdk-js: plan: 1) add field normalization (accept embedding/vector) 2) add pre-reshape length assertion that logs request-id and lengths if mismatch 3) revert unsafe concat and make retry only happen before body consumption. Hotfix v1.3.1 will include 1+2, v1.3.2 will address retry semantics.

sam: confirmed workaround unblocks my demo (autobatch off + normalization).

nia: will update quickstart to pin to v1.3.1 when released and add a troubleshooting note: "If you see inconsistent embedding lengths: set REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 and try autobatch=false."

sdk-js: also adding an e2e test that simulates streaming retry + mixed field names so this doesn't regress.

ops-bot: update: INC-2026-330 marked investigating.

sam: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. will re-run demo after the hotfix.
